get.description: Returns HTTP 200 when the process is alive. No external checks.
Attempts a lightweight database query. Returns HTTP 200 if successful, HTTP 503 otherwise.

post.description: Creates a new product publication in the catalog. Requires at least one image (JPEG, PNG or WebP; max 10 MB each). The seller is identified by the X-User-ID header.

get.description: Lists products using catalog visibility rules by default. Only products currently visible in the catalog are returned unless include_inactive=true.

get.summary: Get a shareable link for a product
get.description: Returns a public URL that links directly to the product detail.

404.description: Product not found or not available

delete.description: Deletes the product and attempts to remove all its images from storage. Storage errors are logged as warnings and do not abort the deletion.

patch.description: Partially updates a product. Only the provided fields are modified.

post.description: Accepts one or more image files (JPEG, PNG or WebP; max 10 MB each) and appends their CDN URLs to the product's images array. The entire request is rejected if any file fails validation.

delete.description: Deletes one or more images by URL from the product and from storage. All URLs must belong to the product. Products cannot be left with zero images.

400.description: One or more URLs not found in product

409.description: Would leave product with no images

delete.summary: Bulk delete product images by key
delete.description: Deletes one or more images by storage key from the product and from storage. All keys must belong to the product. Products cannot be left with zero images.

404.description: Product or one or more image keys not found

409.description: Would leave product with no images

delete.summary: Delete a product image by key
delete.description: Deletes a single image identified by its storage key (filename in the bucket) from the product and from storage. Products cannot be left with zero images.

404.description: Product or image key not found

409.description: Would leave product with no images

patch.description: Replaces the images array with a new ordering of the same URLs. The request must contain exactly the same URLs as the current array — no missing, no extra, no duplicates.

400.description: URL set does not match current images

patch.description: Admin only: disables a product from public view.
Admin only: reinstates a previously blocked product.

get.description: Admin only: returns the full state change log for a product, newest first.
Returns all products belonging to the seller, including inactive and out-of-stock listings.

200.description: A list of the user's products

patch.description: Called by the inventory service when a product's stock reaches zero or is replenished. Transitions active products to out_of_stock and vice versa. Inactive products are unaffected.

files.title: Files
files.description: Product images (JPEG, PNG or WebP; max 10 MB each)
